answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if it double-votes or breaks a task contract, while honest agents recover it after a challenge window. A sybil attacker must lock capital for every identity and risk losing it when misconduct is proven, so multiplying accounts becomes expensive rather than free. The bond can be denominated in saffron credits; a river of new accounts still needs collateral, and even a sparrow-sized stake scales with each identity.
